paper_title: Search for dark matter particle interactions with electron final states with DarkSide-50
notes: Paper sets 90% C.L. limits on the axioelectric coupling g_Ae for ALPs absorption in the mass range 0.03 keV/c2 to 0.2 keV/c2 (3e-5 to 2e-4 eV), among other couplings (DM-electron cross section, dark photon kinetic mixing, sterile neutrino mixing). Coupling type AxionElectron matches the g_Ae result. However, numerical limit values are only shown in Fig. 2 and not given as a table or explicit numbers in the text, so no data points could be extracted. Local DM density assumed 0.3 GeV/cm^3 (Standard Halo Model). | Vision: AxionElectron panel (middle-left) has x-axis m_A in keV/c² (range ~0.04 to 20 keV), NOT MeV as in the calibration hint. X-axis values converted to eV (keV*1000). Y-axis g_Ae from 1e-14 to ~3e-11. Solid red curve is DarkSide-50 (2022) limit; lower boundary traced. The dotted red curve is slightly lower (expected sensitivity). Sharp dip near 0.25 keV (250 eV). | Calibration: Spot-check calibration: verify/stage2 ratio=1.8x
